    Syllabus coverage and scientific conventions

      Taxonomic names follow the supplied syllabus while noting important current usage. “Protozoa,” “Coelenterata” and “Aschelminthes” are retained as curriculum terms, but they are not treated as equivalent modern monophyletic phyla. The sharpened textbook-style drawings remain interpretive learning models and must be compared with specimens, permanent slides and authoritative zoology texts.

      Comparative atlas — one function across all nine organisms

      Pick a functional theme to see how each type-study organism solves the same biological problem, side by side.
